title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Private Rental Agreement Terms
content:
**Clause 1 — Charges.** A private rental of a Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed is charged the class's private monthly rent per month in advance, on the anniversary of the delivery date, plus the class's private rental delivery and setup fee with the first month, for at least the class's minimum private rental term in months.

**Clause 2 — Final part-month.** After the minimum, a final part-month ending on the pickup date is prorated by day where the class's daily-proration value is Yes: the monthly rent multiplied by the days used and divided by the days in that rental month, rounded to the cent half up. The overpaid remainder is refunded to the card.

**Clause 3 — Status.** A private rental month is charged only while the bed record is rental active; the bed record's status in the system is the evidence, read before the month is charged.

**Clause 4 — No conversion.** A private rental never becomes a coverage rental retroactively; a family that obtains coverage starts a new coverage-billed record.

The monthly rent, delivery and setup fee, minimum term and daily-proration value are the bed class's published private rental prices.

## Worked charges (hypothetical rental of a Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260))

Prices used: monthly rent $189.00, delivery and setup fee $95.00, minimum term 1 month, daily proration Yes.

| Charge | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| First month, on the delivery date | $189.00 rent together with the $95.00 delivery and setup fee | $284.00 |
| Each later month, on the delivery-date anniversary | Rent in advance | $189.00 |
| Final part-month of a 30-day rental month, 11 days used (hypothetical) | $189.00 multiplied by 11 and divided by 30 is 69.30 | $69.30; $119.70 of the $189.00 paid in advance refunded |
| Final part-month of a 31-day rental month, 7 days used (hypothetical) | $189.00 multiplied by 7 and divided by 31 is 42.677…, rounded half up | $42.68; $146.32 of the $189.00 paid in advance refunded |

## Points of judgement

- **Inside the minimum term.** The proration in Clause 2 applies after the minimum term; the first month is charged in full.
- **Bed record not rental active.** No private rental month is charged.
- **Coverage obtained during a private rental.** The private months stay private; a new coverage-billed record is started.
